expected: terminal public payload has no controls
late private action replaced by public terminal panel
private hand UIDs absent from public payload
terminal public payload has no controls
physical card UIDs conserved and hidden from public state

invariants.offlineDiscord: real handleDuelComponent/handleTagComponent and discord.js builders; validateDiscordPayload
invariants.playerAssets: players, player_cards, starter_grants, decks and deck_cards unchanged

Testa integração de handlers e stores; não altera comandos de produção.
Não certifica cartas nem altera catálogo.
